svg.title: Inter-technique offset precision against the local tie
svg.desc: Precision of the offsets between laser ranging, VLBI and GNSS positions of one spacecraft, against the error of the ground local tie, from a real run of engine v0.38.0 on scenarios/lunar-infrastructure-space-tie.toml (one 6.56-day arc, technique sigmas GNSS 10 m, VLBI 1 m, laser 0.1 m). With a local tie from 1 mm to 1 m, the laser-minus-GNSS translation sigma stays near 1.04 m until the tie reaches 1 m: it is limited by the measurement noise of the techniques, not by the local tie. The floor set by the tie alone is the square root of two times its sigma. MODELLED: a restricted three-body model with stated simplifications and illustrative inputs, not a measurement of any lunar quantity. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
